t: The Khalili Collections are eight separate art collections, put together over five decades by Nasser Khalili. Between them they hold some 35,000 works of art, and each collection is considered among the most important in its field. Sir Nasser Khalili is a scholar, collector and philanthropist based in London. He was born in Iran, studied at Queens College of the City University of New York and at the School of Oriental and African Studies in London, and is a naturalised British citizen.
